name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Edit（单节点 llama.cpp）
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（176.9B，51.2B n-gram/PLE 查找表由 NVMe 流式加载）单节点 llama.cpp 服务——编程编辑路线：unsloth GGUF UD-Q4_K_XL（~104GiB + mmproj 视觉投影）、ngram-mod 上下文复制投机（exact，输出字节一致；改文件 88 tok/s）、-lm mmap + -ot per_layer_token_embd=CPU（PLE 表留 NVMe 页缓存）、f16 KV、--parallel 2（每槽 131,072）、262,144 上下文、多模态 mmproj 0.967。源自 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark edit 路线。
description_en: Single-node llama.cpp serving for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176.9B, with the 51.2B n-gram/PLE lookup table streamed from NVMe) — the coding-edit lane: unsloth GGUF UD-Q4_K_XL (~104 GiB + mmproj vision projector), ngram-mod context-copying speculation (exact, byte-identical output; 88 tok/s on file rewrites), -lm mmap + -ot per_layer_token_embd=CPU (PLE table served from the NVMe page cache), f16 KV, --parallel 2 (131,072 per slot), 262,144 context, multimodal mmproj 0.967. From the edit lane of 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark.
compose_template:
services:
  llamacpp-qwen38fn:
    image: ${LLAMACPP_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/qwen38-flash-next-edit:v1.0.0}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-qwen38fn-edit
    healthcheck:
      test: [\"CMD\", \"python3\", \"-c\", \"import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${LLAMACPP_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)\"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "16gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    volumes:
      # GGUF 由管理平台分发到节点 HF 缓存（HF_HOME=/hf），容器按 repo id + snapshot 解析
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/hf
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /hf
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      HF_TOKEN: "${HF_TOKEN:-}"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        set -e;
        HUB="$HF_HOME/hub/models--$(printf %s ${QWN38_GGUF_REPO:-unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF} | sed 's|/|--|g')";
        SNAP="$(ls -d $HUB/snapshots/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)";
        GGUF="$(ls $SNAP/UD-Q4_K_XL/*00001-of-*.gguf 2>/dev/null | head -1)";
        [ -n "$GGUF" ] || { echo "GGUF not found (repo ${QWN38_GGUF_REPO:-unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF}) under $HF_HOME - distribute UD-Q4_K_XL/* + mmproj-F16.gguf first"; exit 1; };
        MMFLAG="";
        if [ "${MMPROJ_MODE:-auto}" != "none" ] && [ -f "$SNAP/mmproj-F16.gguf" ]; then MMFLAG="--mmproj $SNAP/mmproj-F16.gguf"; fi;
        EXTRA_ARGV="";
        if [ -n "${EXTRA_ARGS:-}" ]; then EXTRA_ARGV="${EXTRA_ARGS}"; fi;
        exec llama-server -m "$GGUF"
        --alias ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-qwen3.8-flash-next}
        -lm mmap
        -ot per_layer_token_embd=CPU
        --n-gpu-layers 999
        --ctx-size ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-262144}
        --parallel ${PARALLEL:-2}
        $( [ "${SPEC:-ngram-mod}" != "none" ] && echo "--spec-type ${SPEC:-ngram-mod}" )
        $MMFLAG
        --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${LLAMACPP_PORT:-8000}
        $EXTRA_ARGV

variables.label: llama.cpp 镜像
variables.help: ACR 烘焙镜像（源自 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark recipes/llamacpp-edit/Dockerfile：CUDA 13 devel 阶段构建 llama.cpp @qwen4exp PR 035e227 + runtime 精简，仅留 llama-server/llama-cli）
variables.help_en: ACR-baked image (from 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark recipes/llamacpp-edit/Dockerfile: CUDA 13 devel stage builds llama.cpp @qwen4exp PR 035e227 + slim runtime with only llama-server/llama-cli)

variables.label: GGUF 模型仓库
variables.help: unsloth GGUF 仓库：只需 UD-Q4_K_XL/* 分片（~104GiB）+ mmproj-F16.gguf（~0.9GiB，视觉投影）分发给节点 HF 缓存；勿改低比特 K-quant 求快（UD-Q3_K_XL 反而慢 14%）
variables.help_en: unsloth GGUF repo: only UD-Q4_K_XL/* shards (~104 GiB) + mmproj-F16.gguf (~0.9 GiB vision projector) need to reach the node HF cache; do not drop to a lower-bit K-quant for speed (UD-Q3_K_XL is 14% slower)

variables.label: 上下文长度
variables.help: llama.cpp 按 PARALLEL 平分：2 槽时每请求 131,072 token，超长 400（两槽下 161K token 的 prefill 会整个失败，PARALLEL=1 恢复全窗）
variables.help_en: llama.cpp splits CTX across slots: at PARALLEL=2 each request gets 131,072 tokens, longer returns 400 (a 161K-token prefill fails entirely at two slots; PARALLEL=1 restores the full window)

variables.label: 并发槽（parallel）
variables.help: 2（默认）= 双请求各 131,072 上下文，负载下 1.24-1.30x；1 = 恢复整窗 262,144；别拉太高（64 槽会抖动 prompt cache 丢请求）
variables.help_en: 2 (default) = two requests at 131,072 context each, 1.24-1.30x under load; 1 = restore the full 262,144 window; don't push high (64 slots thrashes the prompt cache and loses requests)

variables.label: 投机模式
variables.help: ngram-mod（默认）= 从 prompt 复制候选跨度的上下文投机（exact、输出字节一致；改文件 88 tok/s、自由文本 ~28）；none = 关闭
variables.help_en: ngram-mod (default) = context-copying speculation that lifts spans from your prompt (exact, byte-identical output; 88 tok/s on file rewrites, ~28 free-form); none = off

variables.label: 视觉投影
variables.help: auto（默认）= 缓存里有 mmproj-F16.gguf 就传 --mmproj（图像 0.967）；none = 纯文本
variables.help_en: auto (default) = pass --mmproj when mmproj-F16.gguf is present in the cache (0.967 vision); none = text-only

variables.label: 附加 llama-server 参数
variables.help: 追加到命令尾部的空格分隔参数（如 --gpu-layers-percent 或自定义 sampler）
variables.help_en: Space-separated args appended at the end of the command (e.g. sampler overrides)

variables.label: HuggingFace Token
variables.help: 受 gating 的模型授权 token；模型已由管理平台分发到缓存时通常可留空
variables.help_en: Auth token for gated models; usually empty when the model is pre-distributed to the cache
